non_blocking: CodeMartV1DemoSeeder.php:756-760: ensure() writes the secret file before seedAccounts() and apply(). If either throws, the next seed sees an existing file (generated=false) and never applies it, so the printed password would not work until codemart:admin-password runs (Step175 does this on every deploy). This follows the ruling ('with an existing file the seeder never rehashes') and is acceptable. Record it for codemart-laravel-G1 in case the ruling is revisited.
